title: Flies System – Animated Fly Swarm for Unity
subtitle: Customizable Animated Flies Swarm System
description:
Create realistic fly swarm effects in your Unity scenes with this customizable Flies System, designed to simulate small groups of flies moving around selected objects and environmental areas.

The system allows you to create and control flying insects around objects such as garbage bags, trash piles, and other environmental props. The provided demonstration showcases flies in a dark, abandoned-looking environment with garbage bags, making it particularly suitable for horror, survival, and urban environments.

Using the included Flies System component, developers can adjust the number of flies, movement radius, forward speed, angular speed, and orientation to create different swarm behaviors.

The system also provides randomized movement settings, optional trail effects, and distance-based optimization controls to help manage processing when the system is far from the relevant viewing area.

**Key Features:**
- Customizable animated fly swarm system
- Adjustable fly count and movement radius
- Configurable forward and angular speeds
- Randomized movement speed options
- Adjustable orientation and update time
- Optional trail effects for individual flies
- Distance-based pause and optimization settings
- Debug visualization for system setup
- Randomize option for quick parameter variations
- Included setup and configuration guide

**Perfect For:**
- Horror and survival games
- Abandoned buildings and dark environments
- Garbage and waste disposal areas
- Urban and industrial environments
- Environmental atmosphere and background effects
- Nature and outdoor scenes

The Flies System can be attached to selected objects or created on a separate GameObject, allowing developers to customize fly movement around different locations.

Add atmospheric flying insect activity to your Unity environments with this flexible and configurable Flies System.
